items.headline: 9 touchdowns of at least 30 yards highlights FAU's 51-49 win over Rice
items.description: — Easton Messer piled up 262 all-purpose yards and scored five touchdowns and Florida Atlantic earned a 51-49 win over Rice, which had a four-TD day by quarterback Gael Ochoa in his first start on Saturday.
